goals.name: Traject interview-prep session (main process for a screen/interview)
goals.description: Traject interview-prep session (main process for a screen/interview) [traject-interview-prep-session] — compiled from capabilities/harnesses/traject-interview-prep-session.yaml

gates.name: I1 the room is a data module in Lucy's Stage 0-8 order plus Run
gates.description: the room is a data module in Lucy's Stage 0-8 order plus Run of Show / DECISIONS / debrief, holds only résumé-verified claims, and cleared story.bank + jd.decode
gates.command: room path (src/lib/<company>Content.ts) and both decision ids

gates.name: I2 every drilled answer states a number or NONE and cleared int
gates.description: every drilled answer states a number or NONE and cleared interview.answer (required signals above 0.9); the floor and banned claims are never spoken

gates.name: I3 the 5-line debrief is saved within 2h to .traject/debriefs/
gates.description: the 5-line debrief is saved within 2h to .traject/debriefs/ and the room debrief tab

preconditions.startup_phrase: I drill numbers and gaps; I do not invent a proof line.

quality_criteria: the room is a data module in Lucy's Stage 0-8 order plus Run of Show / DECISIONS / debrief, holds only résumé-verified claims, and cleared story.bank + jd.decode
every drilled answer states a number or NONE and cleared interview.answer (required signals above 0.9); the floor and banned claims are never spoken
the 5-line debrief is saved within 2h to .traject/debriefs/ and the room debrief tab
anti_patterns: Padding a room with an OWNER-ONLY or BANNED claim to sound strong
A drill rep that answers the adjacent question with zero numbers (the Sep 17 failure)
Calling an ATS_SUBMITTED row an interview without a Screen/Interview stage
